# Sophia

> A door outside the five-world palindrome. Dave asked for a world called Sophia. It is not World IV SONIA, and it is not a world 6. SONIA stays the Russian world.

Keeper: Sophia. The door is this index. Each page is a five-window pentaptych. The page recomputes its identity on load and throws if the check slips.

The door seats every page in the shape 1 × 3 × 6 × 9 × 11 × 11 × 9 × 6 × 3 × 1. The shape holds 60, and it is drawn twice for the 120 pages. The five rooms are the colors of the seats.

- [The door](./index.html)
- [Birth seal](./seals/sophia.dlw) — sha256(name|slug|blurb), write-if-missing.

Five rooms:

- the Russian — letters, the calendar, the machine of three
- the ternary — balanced digits −1, 0, +1
- the geometry — polygons, the five solids, Cassini
- the count — combinations and old lists, as arithmetic only
- the root — Sanskrit svastika, from su + asti + ka, sandhi ua → va

Every page draws its subject in the water window. Running the series grows that figure. The drawing is generated by the page.

The root pages that draw the quarter-turn use four arms at 0, 90, 180, and 270, in plain metal gray, labeled C4. Not the Flag says the 1920s–30s political emblem was a hijacking by a regime that murdered millions, and that page does not draw the flag. Language, Not Race says a language family is not a race. The other root pages draw the word, the join, or a crank. They do not draw another cross.

Claims are LIT when the page checks them, AMBER when a name sits beside the count, and WALL when the count does not show the further claim. A gloss is not a charm. Formal validity is not empirical truth.

Host: DavidWise01/sophia. One host. The hallway links here from https://0root.ai/.
